speaker: Doctor
text: I notice you haven't described your symptoms yet. To begin my evaluation, please describe the appearance, size, and duration of the skin lesions you are concerned about, and whether they have changed recently.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the history of syphilis and eczema treatment failure combined with your heavy smoking history raises significant concern for malignancy. Given the location and appearance of these lesions, have you noticed any pain, bleeding, or rapid growth in the most recent weeks? REQUEST TEST: Biopsy of penile and digital lesions; REQUEST IMAGES: Clinical photographs of the lesions.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Biopsy Findings: Cells with nuclear hyperchromasia, multinucleation, and increased mitotic figures within the follicle-bearing epithelium. STD_Panel: Syphilis (Negative), HIV (Negative), HBV (Negative), HCV (Negative).

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Non-healing, crusty, red lesions on the penile shaft and left middle finger. I also have Lesions are painless, History of unsuccessful treatment for syphilis and eczema.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No known malignancies or hereditary diseases in the family. Previous treatments for syphilis and eczema. Social history: Lives with his 4th wife, smokes 2 packs of cigarettes per day for the last 30 years, has recently immigrated from Africa.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies any systemic symptoms such as fever, weight loss, night sweats, or malaise. No other similar lesions elsewhere on the body. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Squamous Cell Carcinoma (Penile and Digital).
